column1: # Morocco, the Ministry of Habous and Islamic Affairs (habous.gov.ma): a table for each of about 190 places, every
# place a unit of its own (rulings R195–R199, 13 Nov 2026). Africa/Casablanca; the clock column says how each file
# is read. Standard Asr. Habous prints no imsak: the fast begins at its Fajr (F+E).
# - The month files (data/horaires-YYYY-MM.js, one file for every place, read 12 Nov 2026 by one plain GET each:
#   archive/tables/manual/ma-habous/2026-11-12/ville-<id>-<month>.txt, printed in UTC+0). 188 places in 187 units:
#   Agoudal is printed twice (ville 309, and 310 for a lower horizon), both against the one unit; Sebta (24) and
#   Melilla (40) are not units and have no row: the app places Ceuta and Melilla in Spain, where this entry does
#   not apply (their four files are held beside the others).
# - Fitted on each place's November 2026 alone: Habous's own point for it (from Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr and Isha, to
#   0.01°), its horizon (to 0.1°) and its sunrise and Maghrib margins (registry/data/HabousCities.kt), then a
#   safety of 20 s at the nine cities held over other seasons and 40 s at a place held for this autumn alone. A
#   one-autumn place's table is also read 0.05° of latitude north and south of its point, each start the latest of
#   the three and each end the earliest: 0.01° is all one month fixes of a point's latitude, and the other
#   seasons' days lean on it most.
# - Held out: every October 2026 file, the live month of 13 Sep–12 Oct 2026 (the ten cities' off-habous files read
#   by habous-live, the 29 places read by hand on 6 Oct 2026 and the monitor's captures of 13 Oct 2026), and nine
#   cities' Wayback pages of 2015–2025, printed in legal time and read into UTC by habous-archive (see
#   HabousArchiveFormat: a page keeps its own clock, not tzdata's, around Ramadan). habous-archive skips the
#   misdated days: the Laayoune capture of 19 Sep 2020 is dated October from 19 Oct 2020, where its Dhuhr jumps by
#   about 9 min (those days are September's), and two runs on the default page (28–31 Jan 2020 and 1–6 Oct 2021)
# - The national margins for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr and Isha and the end of eating are the largest need of any day here,
#   fit or held out, and 5 s more (a place held for one autumn alone takes 10 s beyond them): the held-out days
#   asked for 2 s more at Fajr, 1 s at Dhuhr and 3 s at Asr than November alone. At sunrise and Maghrib the
#   held-out days used at most 6 s of a one-autumn place's 40 s and 9 s of the nine cities' 20 s.
# - The site's default page and the Ramadan 1445 page, filed without a city, are Rabat's: their Dhuhr sits as far
#   after Rabat's transit as Rabat's own page's does (about 5 min).
# - The rows with coordinates are the app's own point for a town (and Imilchil's, about 2,150 m), which resolves to
#   that town's unit: the app's day there against the town's own table, a few km off Habous's point.
# ma_laayoune_202405.txt and off-habous-casa.txt repeat the round files' days.
